entries.code_description: Ozone therapy, oxygen therapy, aerosol therapy, artificial respiration or other therapeutic respiration apparatus
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category  XXIII, N° 11 - external defibrillators (ED)

The reduce rates only apply for: 
- batteries intended for ED: 8506 5090 90, 8507 6000 90
- specific software and specific data storage card + Remotes for ED: 
8523 5110, 8523 5190, 8543 7090
- ED: 9018 9084
- first aid or intervention kits linked to the use of the external defibrillator 9019 2000
- cabinets specially designed for the storage of ED: 9402 9000

Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, cat. XXIII, n° 3 to 5

- walking frames: 8716 8000
- apparatus to be worn on the person and allowing continuous or intermittent injection of medicaments by means of a hypodermic needle supplied by an electronically controlled pump: 9018 3110
- outpatient rehabilitators:  9019 1090
- aerosol devices and their accessories: 9019 2000  
- anti-decubitus material: 9404 90 90
